annotations.title: Move, Rename, or Remove Mounted Equipment

description: Move, rename, or destructively remove an existing mounted device or child sub-module in the active rack, recalculate 3D cable splines, and re-run 5-stage validation. 'instance_id' resolves across top-level devices and carrier sub-modules, and required fields depend on 'action': 'move' updates 'u_position' and 'face' on rackmount gear or 'slot_id' and optional 'parent_carrier_id' across carriers for sub-modules with primary fields taking precedence over 'new_*' aliases, 'rename' updates or clears 'hostname', and 'remove' cascades to child sub-modules plus attached cables and external endpoints when 'remove_connected_cables' is true. Pushes the prior state onto the undo stack and updates rack.yaml atomically, or returns status 'INVALID' without mutating state when 'instance_id' or a target carrier is unknown. Use to update or delete a mounted instance; use mount_equipment to add new hardware, or disconnect_cables to remove cables while keeping devices mounted.

action.description: Modification operation: "move" relocates a device, "rename" updates its hostname, and "remove" deletes the device instance.

face.description: New mounting face ("front" or "rear") when action is "move" on a rackmount device (takes precedence over new_face).

hostname.description: New logical hostname when action is "rename" (takes precedence over new_hostname).

instance_id.description: Existing mounted device or child sub-module instance_id to modify.

new_face.description: Optional alias for face when action is "move".

new_hostname.description: Optional alias for hostname when action is "rename".

new_u_position.description: Optional alias for u_position when action is "move".

parent_carrier_id.description: Target parent carrier instance_id when action is "move" on a child sub-module.

remove_connected_cables.description: When action is "remove", whether to automatically disconnect all cables and external endpoints attached to the removed device (default: true).

slot_id.description: Target slot_id inside parent_carrier_id when action is "move" on a child sub-module.

u_position.description: New 1-indexed U position when action is "move" on a direct rackmount device (takes precedence over new_u_position).
